lines.text: Jesus goes into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan, and the crowds come to Him again.
Some Pharisees test Jesus about divorce, and they say Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce.
Jesus says Moses wrote it for their hard hearts, but from the days of Noah God made male and female.
A man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two become one flesh.
Back inside the house, the scribes ask Jesus about this, and He says divorcing and marrying another is adultery.
